verdict.rationale: A package manager could plausibly offer AI-driven dependency insights or upgrade suggestions, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows pnpm generating AI insights or suggestions from user data. Features like `pnpm audit --fix` and license listing are deterministic tooling, not AI-generated insights, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
